gjort: 4 Norwegian videos are live in DRYTREK_NO_Damasker Vandring, all ACTIVE.
BOF_10_H1 opened a new adset, DRYTREK_NO_BOF. CI_3_H1 opened DRYTREK_NO_CI. PD_16_H1 and PD_8_H1 went to DRYTREK_NO_PD.
Each one got a Norwegian voice-over from HeyGen plus Norwegian burned-in captions replacing the Swedish ones.
PD_8_H1 finally cleared HeyGen moderation from yesterday and went up today. Its burned-in English claim block is painted out and the returns line now reads 14 days.
The Norwegian campaign now runs 45 ads, all ACTIVE: PD 27, SP 7, CS 4, G 4, CI 1, BOF 1, FO 1.
varningar: 2 videos are still held back for the third day running: FO_2_H1 and SP_6_H1. The voice check is red on both.

Both were re-rendered once with a much shorter closing line and the measured value did not move at all, which means the check is reading the background music rather than the voice. A red video is never uploaded, so they stay in the queue.
The Norwegian files are not attached to the Notion rows — the upload of files over the REST API is not built yet. Review the finished ads in Ads Manager.

The caption tool missed the pill in three places where it sits on bright snow, and Swedish text survived in CI_3_H1 on the first pass. Fixed with manual plates and verified frame by frame. This is the third time the same cause has shown up.
